# safegit unlock

release a stale .lock file left behind by a crashed git process

**Effect:** mutating

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` | str | required | the ref name (e.g. refs/heads/main) whose stale .lock file to remove |
